traces.origin: CoMon / PlanetLab VM CPU utilization, March-April 2011
traces.sample: one value per 5 minutes, percent CPU, 288 samples = 24 h
traces.license: as published by the CoMon/PlanetLab trace release used in CloudSim
traces.what_it_is: Recorded host/VM CPU utilization. Not metrics-server millicores, not a kubelet scrape.
traces.how_we_use_it: Open-loop: treat percent/100 as the HPA resource metric (usage/request) that metrics-server would expose. Closed-loop: use the series shape as demand into the 15s plant.
traces.kind_cluster: not available in this environment; see scripts/kind_capture.sh for the live capture contract
